breakfast.name: Homemade Banana Bread
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees.Beat together butter, sugar, vanilla, egg.
Add bananas.With a potato masher or a fork, mash in banana and mix well.
Add flour, baking soda, and salt.Stir until everything is combined.
Add nuts and stir again.Spray a loaf pan with non-stick cooking spray.
Pour mixture into loaf pan.Cook for 55-65 minutes or until an inserted tooth pick comes out clean.

lunch.name: Spicy Salmon Patties
ingredients: 1/4 cup fresh or dried parsley flakes
steps: Prep salmon: remove skin; crush bones with thumb and index finger leaving them in for added calcium.
Knead together salmon with eggs, parsley, scallions, bread crumbs, lemon juice and red pepper flakes.
Cook in a lightly-oiled cast-iron pan over medium heat until golden brown.

dinner.name: Spare Ribs
ingredients: 1 piece fresh ginger root - (½") finely chopped
steps: Combine all the ingredients, except the spare ribs, in a jug and mix well.
Pour over the ribs and leave to marinate for as long as possible, ideally overnight.
Place the ribs on a rack in a roasting pan. Cook in a preheated oven at 400 degrees for about 45 minutes, turning the ribs over half way through the cooking time. Allow to cool and serve cold.
